glossary.role: Anavel Gato's epithet. ソロモン never appears alone in ACE2.
Leader of the Delaz Fleet and mastermind of Operation Stardust; former Zeon colonel loyal to Gihren Zabi. Wiki rank: Lieutenant General (0083).
glossary.personality: Zealous idealist devoted to Spacenoid independence and Gihren's cause; stern but paternal toward Gato; dies shouting "Sieg Zeon".

glossary.role: Main antagonist of 0083; Zeon ace "Nightmare of Solomon", Delaz Fleet pilot who steals Gundam GP02 and later pilots the Neue Ziel. Rank: Major (U.C. 0083).
glossary.personality: Honorable, idealistic career soldier; charismatic leader who fights on the front line; hates the Federation but respects worthy opponents.

glossary.role: Captain and top ace of the Giganos Imperial Guard armored corps ("Blue Hawk of Giganos"); Falguen pilot; Linda's older brother
glossary.personality: Noble, calm and honorable; devoted to Marshal Guiltorre; resents his father Lang for defecting; later turns against Dorchenov

glossary.role: Protagonist of 0083; 19-year-old Earth Federation test pilot from Torrington Base assigned to the Albion; pilots Gundam GP01 and GP03. Rank: Ensign (少尉).
glossary.personality: Hot-tempered and rash, often questions orders; mobile suit otaku; fiercely protective of Nina; driven by intense rivalry with Gato.

glossary.role: Pilot of Dragonar-1 (D-1); Earth Alliance/Federation trainee promoted to Warrant Officer; protagonist
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, impulsive, acts before thinking; chases Linda; resents his absent father

report.translator_summary: Completed translation of op06_02 (80 rows). Covers the aftermath of the nuclear strike at Konpei Island, Phase 2 tactical briefing where Burning rallies the squad to pursue Gundam GP02 (Unit 2), and extended multi-character duel dialogue with Anavel Gato as Kou Uraki, Kaine Wakaba, and Tak Kepford clash with Gato over righteousness ('義'), revenge, and duty, concluding with Unit 2's destruction and developer placeholder message lines.
report.rows_examined: m6061#65 to m6062#63 (slice, 80 rows), m6062#64 to brief63173#1 (context_after, 12 rows)

uncertainties.note: Gato's recurring phrase '私は義によって立っているからな！' translated as 'For I stand upon righteousness!', maintaining fidelity to 0083 and INDICE guidelines.
Idiom '鎧袖一触' translated naturally as 'Brushed aside in a single sweep.'
